title: R4a support control wire
description: Route-specific closed HTTP request and response definitions. Device requests alone use sdc.support.v1 and no flat scope claims; admin requests use csrf with registered IDs and the Console prefix. Choose the matching $defs for a route; the root anyOf is only a request-shape union. Raw UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes, identity encoding, depth<=8, duplicate/unknown keys and invalid UTF-8 rejected before schema validation. Schema shape is not authorization or execution evidence. R4a requires case consent plus individual operation approval; automatic preauthorization is not implemented. Console approval persists approved typed payload without a signing key; the Support Broker signs and persists queued operation envelopes during poll after current-authority revalidation. Read-only consent preview returns centrally approved fixed metadata before local consent; it grants no execution authority. Preview requires an explicitly preinstalled consent-preview pin purpose, current registered claim/device/key/full scope and current case/consent/roles. A persisted device declaration of the human-approved local receipt is separately acknowledged by cases/accept before polling/admission/grant. Transport authentication alone is not evidence of local consent. operations/status is metadata-only reconciliation for a known consumed receipt or an exactly matched persisted pregrant admission, including after case expiry or cancellation, while current device/key/realm/tenant authorization remains mandatory.

SignedEnvelope.description: Payload is base64url ASCII CJSON; signature covers SDC-SIGNED-v1 LF purpose LF kid LF decoded CJSON, no final LF. PS256 RSA3072/e65537 SHA256 MGF1SHA256 salt32 trailer 0xbc. The current pinned key and purpose/type must be verified separately.

PollRequest.description: Requires the persisted cases/accept acknowledgment matching the authenticated device/key, case, current epochs and locally approved binding; the central planned consent epoch alone is insufficient.

AdmitRequest.description: Requires the persisted cases/accept acknowledgment matching the authenticated device/key, case, current epochs and locally approved binding; the central planned consent epoch alone is insufficient.

GrantRequest.description: Requires the persisted cases/accept acknowledgment matching the authenticated device/key, case, current epochs and locally approved binding; the central planned consent epoch alone is insufficient.

observed_at.description: Receipt/report generation time in UTC milliseconds; when result is nonnull this equals result.generated_at, not result.observed_at.

ReportRequest.description: Current permitted succeeded requires a nonnull diagnostic DTO with the same diagnostic_id and result.generated_at equal to report.observed_at (receipt generation time). result.observed_at is the separate original source witness time or null; it must not be invented from collection time/counters. Runtime requires result.generated_at >= result.observed_at when nonnull. After case/consent revocation, only this already consumed receipt may report fixed status with result=null. Device/key/realm authorization remains required. state_revision must increase for a new report; late terminal evidence may have an older report generation time while the stored observation watermark never regresses; receipt generation time must not exceed server now+300000. After content-report ACK loss and case cancellation/expiry, use operations/status with the original report ID to reconcile raw body_hash without resending diagnostic bytes or rewriting that report.

PollResponse.description: operation and approval are both null or both present. The individual approval record is not separately signed: the client validates its complete closed fields, recomputes intent/approval hashes and compares approval_hash/id/approved_by/epochs/lifetime with the verified immutable operation. A current accepted device/key/case/epoch-bound local receipt is required even for an empty poll. No preauthorized approval is emitted.

history.description: Latest 100 merged case open/consent/assign/close and device poll/admit/grant/report entries, descending created_at; each source selection rechecks current case scope/read authority.

OperationHistoryItem.description: Fixed case/device request history only; no raw actor, request body or secret. Source rows are filtered by current scope and case.read in their primary SELECT.

ConsentPreviewEnvelope.description: Read-only consent metadata, not an operation or grant. contentSchema is an annotation: runtime must strictly decode ASCII CJSON, validate consent-preview.schema.json, recompute the binding hash, verify PS256 and explicitly pinned consent-preview purpose, and compare registered full scope/claim/current key. Preview lifetime <=5 minutes and consent lifetime <=30 minutes. No dynamic key or origin discovery.

PreviewRequest.description: Exact device bootstrap request. Device/tenant/installation/environment/claim/key are resolved from the authenticated registration, never caller scope fields. Central case consent and current authority are required; local consent receipt is not yet required. No collection or execution is authorized.

PreviewResponse.description: Handler returns schema_version/preview_id/preview; the standard HTTP wrapper adds request_id. Same-ID identical raw request bytes return the identical stored preview envelope without extending expiry; changed bytes conflict with 409. Current authorization still applies. This response cannot approve an operation.

AcceptRequest.description: Exact declaration of a locally persisted receipt after human confirmation of the signed preview. First acceptance must win its current-authority CAS within the five-minute preview lifetime. This ACK records a device declaration, not independent proof of a human action, diagnosis, execution or grant. owner_generation belongs to per-operation admission, not this case receipt.

AcceptResponse.description: The wrapper adds request_id to the persisted receipt ACK. Identical accept_id and raw request bytes return the same stored ACK without extending expires_at; altered bytes are 409. ACK replay may outlive preview signature expiry only while current case consent and all device/key/scope/epoch/realm authorization remain valid. The planned central local_consent_epoch alone is not this acceptance.

StatusRequest.description: Exact metadata-only status request for a known operation/payload/receipt with a consumed grant, or a persisted pregrant admission with grant_id null, nonnull admission_id, state_revision 0 and state locally_admitted/canceled/expired. Pregrant also requires the saved admit request to match tenant/device/case/operation/admission_id and its exact canonical four-field admission ACK to match schema/operation/receipt/locally_admitted, with stored raw body_hash in lowercase SHA-256 form. A planned receipt, missing admission, inconsistent ACK or any report row for the pregrant operation is denied. report_id may be the locally persisted UUID of a report not yet sent. No report body is resent. status_id identifies the observation and reserves no immutable response or side-effect receipt: another authenticated read with that ID may observe newer primary state. Fixed transport nonce protections still apply. Unknown or mismatched IDs/hash/scope are denied without revealing existence.

anyOf.description: Metadata of the saved report with this exact report_id, device, operation, case and receipt. body_hash is SHA-256 of the original raw report bytes, not the diagnostic DTO digest.

operation.description: Current primary operation state; it can be newer than the selected saved report.

StatusResponse.description: Current primary metadata only, guarded before and after the audit commit by active device/credential, full scope, ciphertext, device epoch, nonce, signature time, realm and tenant authorization/expiry. A closed/canceled/expired case does not prevent this one consumed receipt or exactly matched persisted pregrant admission from reconciling. A known pregrant admission normally returns report=null and state_revision 0. report=null means no matching saved report was observed; it proves neither no execution nor authoritative nonacceptance, terminal failure or permission to reexecute. A local slot may be resolved as ended without starting only when local evidence of no provider start agrees with this same operation/hash/receipt in central canceled/expired state; locally_admitted or null alone is insufficient. No diagnostic content, operation/grant signature, URL, key or case list is returned. Local disable still forbids all communication.
